an4.183:1.1: I have heard that on one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Rājagaha in the Bamboo Forest, the Squirrels’ Sanctuary.
an4.183:1.2: Then Vassakāra the brahman, the minister to the king of Magadha, approached the Blessed One and, on arrival, exchanged courteous greetings with him.
an4.183:1.3: After an exchange of friendly greetings & courtesies, he sat to one side.
an4.183:2.1: As he was sitting there he said to the Blessed One:
an4.183:2.2: “I am of the view, of the opinion, that when anyone speaks of what he has seen, (saying,)
an4.183:2.3: ‘Thus have I seen,’ there is no fault in that.
an4.183:2.4: When anyone speaks of what he has heard, (saying,)
an4.183:2.5: ‘Thus have I heard,’ there is no fault in that.
an4.183:2.6: When anyone speaks of what he has sensed, (saying,)
an4.183:2.7: ‘Thus have I sensed,’ there is no fault in that.
an4.183:2.8: When anyone speaks of what he has cognized, (saying,)
an4.183:2.9: ‘Thus have I cognized,’ there is no fault in that.”
an4.183:3.1: (The Blessed One responded:) “I do not say, brahman, that everything that has been seen should be spoken about.
an4.183:3.2: Nor do I say that everything that has been seen should not be spoken about.
an4.183:3.3: I do not say that everything that has been heard…
an4.183:3.7: everything that has been cognized should be spoken about.
an4.183:3.8: Nor do I say that everything that has been cognized should not be spoken about.
an4.183:4.1: “When, for one who speaks of what has been seen, unskillful qualities increase and skillful qualities decrease, then that sort of thing should not be spoken about.
an4.183:4.2: But when, for one who speaks of what has been seen, unskillful qualities decrease and skillful qualities increase, then that sort of thing should be spoken about.
an4.183:5.1: “When, for one who speaks of what has been heard…
an4.183:7.1: what has been cognized, unskillful qualities increase and skillful qualities decrease, then that sort of thing should not be spoken about.
an4.183:7.2: But when, for one who speaks of what has been cognized, unskillful qualities decrease and skillful qualities increase, then that sort of thing should be spoken about.”
an4.183:8.1: Then Vassakāra the brahman, delighting & rejoicing in the Blessed One’s words, got up from his seat and left.
